srList.sentence: Methods Study design The CHART-2 study is a prospective, multicentre, observational cohort study for HF in Japan, and the details have been described previously (UMIN:000000562, NCT00418041). 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 Briefly, 10 219 consecutive stable patients aged >=20 years with coronary artery disease (N = 868), asymptomatic structural heart disease (Stage B, N = 4475), and a current or past history of HF (Stage CD, N = 4876) were registered from the 24 participating hospitals between October 2006 and March 2010.
